subject: Demo recap + proposed POC plan for FinServCo
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Jones <alex.jones@finservco.com>, Sarah Lee <sarah.lee@finservco.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 08 Jun 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Demo recap + proposed POC plan for FinServCo

Hi Alex / Sarah —

Thanks again for your time today. Great conversation — I wanted to follow up with a concise recap of what we demoed and a proposed POC plan so we can align on success criteria, timeline, and owners. I've attached a one-page POC plan for reference (FinServCo_POC_Plan_v1.pdf) and a short SOC2 summary as requested.

Demo recap (high level):
- We walked through Redwood Inference API for text generation + structured outputs, prefix caching to reduce prompt cost, and per-route performance dashboards.
- Showed example of routing to a smaller quantized model for lower-cost inference for non-critical paths.
- Live Q&A on latency under 100ms p50 with our dedicated configuration for similar FinServ workloads.

Proposed POC (4 weeks) — goal: validate accuracy + economics on a representative production workload
1) Success criteria (suggested):
   - Functional: 85%+ top-1 accuracy on your intent-classification labeling set OR equivalent business metric you prefer
   - Performance: 95th percentile latency < 250ms for 8k daily QPS profile (demo-profile attached)
   - Cost: projected per-1k-token inference cost within 20% of our estimate in the POC plan
2) Scope & activities:
   - Week 0: Kickoff, access provisioning (API key, VPC peering option if desired), sample dataset exchange
   - Week 1-2: Ingestion & baseline runs (compare current baseline -> Redwood)
   - Week 3: Optimization & quantization experiments, caching + batching config tuning
   - Week 4: Final evaluation, scorecard, recommendation and next-step proposal
3) Ownership:
   - Redwood: Marissa Cole (primary sales / program owner), Rishi Malhotra (SE - tech lead), Vanessa Ortiz (CS - onboarding & success)
   - FinServCo: Alex Jones (product lead), Sarah Lee (IT / security), Procurement contact to finalize SOW
4) Logistics & items we need from you:
   - Representative sample dataset + labeling guide (anonymized)
   - Expected throughput profile (typical/day and peak)
   - Security questionnaire items (we attached SOC2 summary; we can provide more evidence as needed)

Next steps I propose:
- Confirm success criteria above (reply with edits)
- Confirm owners and preferred kickoff window (we have availability next week: Tue/Wed mornings PT)
- If procurement needs, we can deliver a draft SOW + pricing estimate after success criteria are finalized

Thanks — attaching the plan & SOC2 summary. Happy to hop on a 20-30m kickoff to align.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0112

Attachments: FinServCo_POC_Plan_v1.pdf (one-page), SOC2_Summary_Redwood.pdf

From: Alex Jones <alex.jones@finservco.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sarah Lee <sarah.lee@finservco.com>, procurement@finservco.com
Date: Tue, 09 Jun 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Demo recap + proposed POC plan for FinServCo

Marissa —

Thanks for the detailed recap and the quick turnaround on the POC plan. This looks promising. A couple of notes/requests from our side: 

1) Success criteria: we agree with the accuracy/perf buckets but would prefer the functional metric to be defined as a business impact: reduce manual triage volume by 30% for the claims intake queue (we can provide last-90-day volumes and a labeled sample).
2) Security/compliance: we need a bit more on data residency and encryption-in-transit at a minimum. SOC2 summary is helpful — can you confirm whether Redwood can support private deployment (VPC) for the POC or a hosted environment with dedicated capacity?
3) Timeline: procurement wants the initial SOW and T&Cs before the kickoff. Can you share a draft SOW and a rough price range for a 4-week POC (estimate only)?

We can do a kickoff call on Wednesday 2026-06-10 at 11:00 AM ET (which is 08:00 PT) if that works for your team.

Alex
Product Manager, FinServCo
alex.jones@finservco.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Jones <alex.jones@finservco.com>, Sarah Lee <sarah.lee@finservco.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 09 Jun 2026 15:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Demo recap + proposed POC plan for FinServCo

Alex — thanks for the quick feedback and the concrete success metric. We're aligned on the business outcome (30% reduction in manual triage for claims intake) — that will be the primary acceptance criteria.

Quick responses to your asks:
- Private deployment: yes — for the POC we can support either Redwood Dedicated (reserved capacity) or a VPC-connected private deployment. Rishi and Vanessa will propose the option that hits your security and latency needs with minimum friction.
- Draft SOW & pricing: attaching a short-form SOW draft (SOW_Draft_FinServCo_4wk.pdf) and a price range estimate in the attached POC plan. We will update after success criteria and scope are finalized.
- Procurement kickoff: Wed 2026-06-10 11:00 AM ET works for us. We'll send a calendar invite.

Internal owners / asks: 
- Rishi: can you prepare a short checklist of technical requirements for the kickoff (sample data format, access VPN/keys, token limits, compute preferences) and a quick RACI for the POC?
- Vanessa: please draft an onboarding timeline and any standard CS deliverables (runbook, weekly checkpoints) we should include in the SOW.
- Aditya: FYI — may need approval for small promotional credits depending on final SOW.

Alex / Sarah — we’ll aim to have the SOW and tech checklist to you by EOD tomorrow so procurement has something to review before the kickoff.

Thanks,
Marissa

Hi Alex / Marissa / Sarah —

Thanks — looking forward to the kickoff tomorrow. Quick tech checklist (high level) we plan to cover and items we'll need from FinServCo by kickoff or in Week 0:
- Sample data: 2k-5k anonymized claim records in CSV or JSONL, with a small labeled subset (~200) for validation
- Access: temporary API credentials for Redwood to hit a staging endpoint OR details for VPC peering (preferred if you require private networking)
- Expected throughput: typical/day and peak TPS numbers, and a sample 1-hour trace if available
- Security: contact for your security/infosec team; we will bring the SOC2 summary and can schedule a short evidence call if needed
- Evaluation metrics: confirmation that reduction in manual triage is the primary acceptance metric; please also share current baseline numbers (avg triage time, weekly volume)

Plan for kickoff call:
- Quick intros (5m)
- Review success criteria and scope (10m)
- Access & data plan (10m)
- Timeline & immediate next steps (5m)

Logistics: I’ll bring a short RACI and a runbook template to the call. If FinServCo is able to share the sample dataset ahead of the call, we can start baseline runs within 24-48 hours.

Thanks,
Rishi Malhotra
